'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Nicholas Tobin LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nicholas Tobin]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Nicholas Tobin]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/worlds-2014-reset-beta-event-nicholas-tobin-ls-wys-raiders/ PC list]
